library_name: Destiny Core Prestige Talents — General II
notes: Detailed paraphrases of Core Rulebook Crime Lord, Elite Trooper, and Officer talents.

rules.name: Inspire Fear I
rules.description: Your reputation weakens opponents who are no more experienced than you.

mechanics.target: Opponents whose character level is no greater than yours.
mechanics.effect: Targets take -1 on attack rolls and opposed skill checks against you, and -1 on Use the Force checks to activate powers targeting you.

rules.name: Inspire Fear II
rules.description: Deepen the penalties imposed by your fearsome reputation.

mechanics.effect: The penalty imposed by Inspire Fear becomes -2 instead of -1.

rules.name: Inspire Fear III
rules.description: Your infamy imposes an overwhelming penalty on eligible opponents.

mechanics.effect: The penalty imposed by Inspire Fear becomes -5 instead of -2.

rules.name: Notorious (Crime Lord)
rules.description: Your criminal reputation lets you retry undisguised intimidation.

mechanics.trigger: Make a Persuasion check to intimidate while not disguised.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll the check, but must keep the second result.

rules.name: Shared Notoriety
rules.description: Minions invoke your name to make their threats more reliable.

mechanics.trigger: One of your minions invokes your name while making Persuasion to intimidate.
mechanics.effect: The minion may reroll but must keep the second result.

rules.name: Attract Minion
rules.description: Gain a loyal nonheroic follower whose level scales with yours.

mechanics.effect: Gain a loyal nonheroic minion with class levels equal to three-quarters of your character level, rounded down.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for additional minions, but normally only one accompanies you. An accompanying minion receives an equal party share of XP; calling a replacement requires normal travel time.

rules.name: Impel Ally I
rules.description: Spend your own swift action to make an ally move immediately.

mechanics.use: Swift action; usable up to three times during your turn.
mechanics.effect: The ally immediately moves up to its speed during your turn, before you continue; otherwise the granted movement is lost.

rules.name: Impel Ally II
rules.description: Spend two swift actions to grant an ally an immediate action.

mechanics.effect: The ally immediately takes one standard or move action during your turn, before you continue; otherwise the opportunity is lost.

rules.name: Controlled Burst
rules.description: Control automatic weapon fire with substantially less loss of accuracy.

mechanics.effect: The attack penalty for autofire or Burst Fire is reduced to -2. When you brace an autofire-only weapon, you take no autofire attack penalty.

rules.name: Exotic Weapon Mastery
rules.description: Use every exotic weapon as though proficient with it.

mechanics.effect: You are treated as proficient with all exotic weapons even without the corresponding Exotic Weapon Proficiency feats.

rules.name: Greater Devastating Attack
rules.description: Treat a target's damage threshold as dramatically lower with one chosen weapon group.

feats: Weapon Focus (selected weapon or weapon group)
special: Proficient with selected weapon or group

mechanics.trigger: Hit using the selected exotic weapon or weapon group.
mechanics.effect: Treat the target's damage threshold as 10 lower when resolving the attack; this replaces Devastating Attack's normal reduction.

rules.name: Greater Penetrating Attack
rules.description: Bypass more damage reduction with one selected weapon group.

feats: Weapon Focus (selected weapon or weapon group)
special: Proficient with selected weapon or group

mechanics.trigger: Hit using the selected exotic weapon or weapon group.
mechanics.effect: Treat the target's Damage Reduction as 10 lower when resolving damage; this replaces Penetrating Attack's normal reduction.

rules.name: Greater Weapon Focus
rules.description: Gain another accuracy bonus with one selected weapon group.

feats: Weapon Focus (selected weapon or weapon group)
special: Proficient with selected weapon or group

mechanics.effect: Gain +1 on attacks with the selected exotic weapon or weapon group; this stacks with Weapon Focus.

rules.name: Greater Weapon Specialization
rules.description: Deal still more damage with one specialized weapon group.

feats: Weapon Focus (selected weapon or weapon group)
talents: Weapon Specialization (selected weapon or weapon group)
special: Proficient with selected weapon or group

mechanics.effect: Gain +2 damage with the selected exotic weapon or weapon group, stacking with Weapon Specialization.

rules.name: Multiattack Proficiency (Heavy Weapons)
rules.description: Reduce full-attack penalties when making multiple heavy-weapon attacks.

mechanics.trigger: Make multiple attacks with heavy weapons as a full attack.
mechanics.effect: Reduce the multiple-attack penalty by 2 per selection.

rules.name: Multiattack Proficiency (Rifles)
rules.description: Reduce full-attack penalties when making multiple rifle attacks.

mechanics.trigger: Make multiple attacks with rifles as a full attack.
mechanics.effect: Reduce the multiple-attack penalty by 2 per selection.

rules.name: Assault Tactics
rules.description: Coordinate concentrated attacks against one designated creature.

mechanics.target: One creature; allies must hear and understand you.
mechanics.effect: You and eligible allies deal +1d6 damage to the target with each successful melee or ranged attack.
mechanics.duration: Until start of your next turn.

rules.name: Deployment Tactics
rules.description: Direct allies to exploit flanking or avoid opportunity attacks.

mechanics.effect: You and allies able to see, hear, and understand you gain either +1 competence on attacks against flanked opponents or +1 dodge to Reflex against opportunity attacks.
mechanics.duration: Until start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting. Bonus becomes +2 if you possess Born Leader or Battle Analysis.

rules.name: Field Tactics
rules.description: Help nearby allies extract maximum protection from existing cover.

mechanics.target: You and allies within 10 squares who hear and understand you.
mechanics.effect: Characters who already have cover gain +10 cover to Reflex Defense instead of +5.
mechanics.duration: Until start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting; grants no cover where none exists.

rules.name: One for the Team
rules.description: Shift some or all attack damage between yourself and an adjacent ally.

mechanics.trigger: A single attack damages you or an adjacent ally.
mechanics.effect: You may take half or all damage dealt to the ally; likewise, the adjacent ally may take half or all damage dealt to you even without this talent.
mechanics.special: Transfers damage from that attack, not unrelated effects.

rules.name: Outmaneuver
rules.description: Strip visible enemies of tactical attack and defense bonuses.

mechanics.target: Enemies in your line of sight.
mechanics.check: Knowledge (Tactics) DC 15; the highest-level visible enemy officer may oppose as a reaction and defeats this use with a higher result.
mechanics.effect: Targets lose competence, insight, and morale bonuses on attacks and all dodge bonuses to Reflex Defense.
mechanics.duration: Until start of your next turn.

rules.name: Shift Defense I
rules.description: Trade a penalty to one defense for a small bonus to another.

mechanics.effect: Take -2 to one of Reflex, Fortitude, or Will and gain +1 competence to a different defense.
mechanics.duration: Until start of your next turn.

rules.name: Shift Defense II
rules.description: Make a larger defensive trade between two defenses.

mechanics.effect: Take -5 to one defense and gain +2 competence to a different defense.
mechanics.duration: Until start of your next turn.

rules.name: Shift Defense III
rules.description: Concentrate defense heavily in one area at the expense of the other two.

mechanics.effect: Gain +5 competence to one defense and take -5 to each of the other two defenses.
mechanics.duration: Until start of your next turn.

rules.name: Tactical Edge
rules.description: Issue several common tactical directives more quickly.

mechanics.effect: You may activate Assault Tactics, Deployment Tactics, or Field Tactics as a swift action instead of a move action, provided you possess the talent used.
